purpose: Keep this Base release completely independent from any CIRCLE release, project, service, profile, manifest, domain, URL or receipt.

platforms.write_scope: Base repository main ref and Base release only
pre_write_checks: ref is the Base project ref
release join is the current Base candidate
no CIRCLE project, service, profile, manifest, domain or URL field is present
deployment commit is the current Base GitHub commit
no CIRCLE service, project, domain or environment field is present

platforms.exact_target: Base ERP project-specific Base App entry
platforms.write_scope: Add or update a Base-specific entry without changing any existing account-level project entry
Use the candidate only after an owner-visible readback proves it is the Base project entry
Base project entry or deployment mapping only
Read/verify Base identity; any primary-name mutation requires a separate owner-approved transaction
Base testnet transaction/evidence only; never substitute for Base Mainnet or another project

hard_rules: Never modify, overwrite, reuse, rename or replace any CIRCLE repository, service, app, project, profile entry, release, manifest, domain, URL or receipt.
Before every external write, verify the exact Base target identity against this matrix and the live owner-visible surface.
If a target contains a CIRCLE project ID, name or domain, stop immediately and create an owner/platform gate; do not force coexistence.
If a shared account-level profile cannot hold a separate Base project-specific entry without changing an existing entry, stop at the owner/platform gate.
A receipt counts only when its target is Base-specific and its release_id, release_fingerprint, bom_fingerprint and material_outcome join the current Base release.
CIRCLE receipts, deployments and manifests are never Base evidence.
external_write_protocol: read back native receipt and release join
stop and record owner/platform gate on ambiguity
